question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Nvidia)

calls.reasoning: Q3 FY27 guide: revenue $108B ±2%, 74% gross margin, $9.2B GAAP opex. Assuming the usual beat (about $111B), operating GAAP EPS is about $2.54 at a 16-17.5% tax rate on 24.2B shares. GAAP differs from non-GAAP mainly through mark-to-market gains on equity holdings, at about $0.034 EPS per $1B. Intel is flat over the quarter (92.3 to about 92), SpaceX is down about $14/share on 122.8M shares (about -$1.7B), and CoreWeave has dropped sharply, so public marks are likely net slightly negative. The upside tail is OpenAI's round at $1.4T vs $852B, still unclosed as of Oct 20. If it closes by quarter end (about Oct 25), that adds about +$0.6. No human market found on Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmakers for GAAP EPS; Manifold only has a revenue market.

- Searched, not found: exact CoreWeave and SpaceX prices on Jul 24; Nvidia's other public holdings (Nokia, Synopsys, Arm) Q3 moves; any Q3-window Anthropic or OpenAI priced transaction; human prediction markets on GAAP EPS (none found).

calls.reconciliation: The main factual dispute was SpaceX's price at the start of Q3. Run 1 used ~$171 (the June 30 13F value) and assumed a loss. My search shows SPCX was >50% below its $225.64 intraday ATH on Jul 24, i.e. ≤~$112, and it closed $159.31 on Oct 21 after its Q3 beat. That is ~+$5-6B pretax, so Runs 2/3 were right and Run 1's SpaceX premise was wrong. CoreWeave was ~$82-90 in Jul/Aug versus ~$63 now, ~-$1B. OpenAI round: talks were still ongoing per Oct 20 reports with nothing closed, so a markup by ~Oct 25 is a tail only. Judgment: revenue beat ~5% (consistent with the last two quarters). The lockup expiry on Oct 22 risks some giveback of the SpaceX gain. The result lands between Run 3 and Run 2.
